 bet365 Nations League preview
 There are plenty of highlights to look forward to, as the Nations League group stage draws to a dramatic conclusion. Here we’ll focus on tonight’s clash between Switzerland and Scotland.
 UEFA Nations League Preview – Switzerland vs Scotland: Tonight @ 7.45pm
 witzerland have already done the hard part. Promotion to League A is sealed with a game to spare, and they’ve won four of their five group matches. They’ve scored 11 goals in those four wins and have only conceded once across the five games, so the Swiss have been a cut above Group B1.
 Scotland’s night is a lot more complicated. They sit third, a point behind Slovenia, so they need to win in St Gallen and hope Slovenia draw or lose to North Macedonia. The reverse fixture won’t give them much confidence, as they lost 3-0 at Hampden in September. Jack Hendry was sent off on 11 minutes that night, though, so it’s not the cleanest guide to how these two compare.
 There are some positives for Sebastien Pocognoli. His side scored all five of their goals in the three games after that defeat, including a 2-1 win over North Macedonia last time out. They’re also unbeaten away from home in the group, with one win and one draw. Scott McTominay is back in the squad after his heart operation, and Andy Robertson could make his 102nd appearance and equal Kenny Dalglish’s record.
 With promotion already in the bag, Switzerland might rotate, but even a changed side should have enough to see off a Scotland team that needs a lot to go their way.
